content.short: Light Account is an enterprise-grade, gas-optimized ERC-4337 smart contract account.
content.description: Light Account is an enterprise-grade, gas-optimized ERC-4337 smart contract account with ERC-1271 signature support. It is engineered to be robust, flexible, and upgradeable, designed for a broad range of applications and deployment scenarios. Light Account provides ERC-4337 compliance, security audits, and extendable capabilities, delivering a scalable and secure smart account solution that developers can rely on as their applications evolve and grow in complexity.
